propositions: Reusable gate-duration probe must be extracted and stored as a thin CLI layer in scripts/rebar_duration_probe.py with statistical primitives in scripts/rebar_duration_probe_support.py, both stdlib-only and import-safe.
Gated-close phase breakdown must distinguish direct metrics, direct event intervals, and inferred residuals for pre-verifier, deterministic verifier, LLM verifier, and verdict-to-status transitions.

The probe must preserve existing modes (summary, table, clean, all, unmatched) while implementing CLI contract defaults for --log-root, --tracker, --since, --until, --provider-prefix, and --current-since parameters.
No-LLM, forced, status/check/help, unmatched, and interrupted operations must remain distinguishable from completed model-backed cohorts in classification output.
Frozen command `python scripts/rebar_duration_probe.py summary --tracker .tickets-tracker [...]` must reproduce provider-clean window with unchanged percentiles.
Focused synthetic tests must validate command classification, terminal reconstruction, percentile calculation, and cohort filtering without external dependencies or import-time side effects.
